subject: Artifact list & timelines for retention/erasure evidence requested
messages:
From: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@fintrust.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Audit Team <soc2-audit@fintrust.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: retention + deletion artifact list for SOC2 prep

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking this on. Our SOC 2 team needs a consolidated list of artifacts that prove Redwood's retention and deletion controls for the period Jan 1, 2025 — Apr 30, 2026. Specifically we need: 

- Canonical retention TTLs for primary customer artifacts (tokens, chat transcripts, embeddings, logs)
- Evidence of deletions (audit logs, job run IDs, S3 object manifests) with timestamps and hashes where applicable
- Any legal hold/exception records during the window
- Mapping of retention policy -> storage location (S3 path / DB / index) and the responsible service/team

Can you provide a single consolidated artifact list and a proposed delivery schedule by EOD Friday, May 15? Our auditors want to kick off verification the following week.

If there are any blockers (e.g., need engineering pull or export access), flag them and we can escalate.

Appreciate it,
Lara
Security / Third-Party Risk
FinTrust Bank
[attachment: audit-template.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)]

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@fintrust.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention + deletion artifact list for SOC2 prep

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear ask.

Quick update: we can assemble the list and exports but will need two engineering pulls (S3 manifest export and DB deletion-trace extracts). Mina and David are looped to scope the exports and confirm timelines.

Proposed plan (high-level):
1) Today/Tomorrow: internal mapping + index of where artifacts live (I can deliver a CSV index)
2) Wed, May 13: S3 manifest export + DB deletion logs (initial)
3) Thu, May 14: Hash verification report and cross-check with manifests
4) Fri, May 15: Consolidated artifact package + links and short README (delivery)

If that works I will include a checklist of exactly which files and sample records the auditors will want to inspect.

Tessa
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
[attachment: retention-mapping-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 72KB)]

>

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: scope the exports for FinTrust SOC2 ask — action items

Mina / David —

FinTrust needs a package proving retention+deletion for Jan 1, 2025 — Apr 30, 2026. Auditor ask is specific (manifests, deletion audit logs, proof of hash verification). Please see the initial plan above and confirm the following by end of day today:

- Mina: can you produce a canonical list of retention TTLs and note any policy exceptions / legal holds in that window? Please include: token TTL, customer transcript retention, embeddings retention, request/response logs, and long-term audit logs. Output: retention-evidence-index-20260515.csv
- David: can you scope the engineering exports — S3 manifest export for archived buckets, DB soft-delete/hard-delete event logs, and our vector index purge logs. For each export include: export job ID, start/end timestamp, object counts, S3 prefixes, and MD5/SHA256 where available. Output: s3-exports-20260514.json and deletion-trace-20260514.log

Also list any approvals required to run bulk exports or retention-scoped reads (IAM roles, ticket numbers). We're on a tight timeline — auditors expect the package Friday. If either of you foresee a blocker, call it out and I'll escalate to Ops./Eng.

Thanks,
Tessa

[-- internal note: we will redact PII from sample records before handing over]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: scope the exports for FinTrust SOC2 ask — action items

Tessa / David —

Status & artifacts I can produce by Thu, May 14: 

1) retention-evidence-index-20260515.csv — mapping of policy name -> artifact type -> TTL -> storage location -> owner. Sample rows: 
   - tokens | token-store | 30d | s3://redwood-tokens/prod/ | service-auth
   - chat_transcripts | transcript-store | 365d | s3://redwood-transcripts/prod/ | convo-service
   - embeddings | vector-db | 180d (compacted) | redisml://vectors/region-us | embedding-service

2) legal-holds-log.csv — records of holds/escapes (none active in window; 2 short exceptions in 2025-08 for litigation hold; details included with redaction)

3) deletion-policy-extract.txt — canonical text snippets from policy engine version v2.1 used in 2025 and 2026 (will list commit id and policy rollout date)

Notes / caveats: 
- Embedding compaction runs are incremental; the "180d" is a functional retention after compaction; raw shards may live briefly in warm storage for up to 14 days post-compaction. I will document these transient windows.
- Search index deletions are best-effort and include eventual consistency windows (I will include TTLs and expected convergence time).

Attachments: retention-evidence-index-20260515.csv (CSV stub), retention-policy-refs.txt

Mina
Sr. Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 16:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: scope the exports for FinTrust SOC2 ask — action items

Team —

Exports completed and uploaded to the compliance S3 path (read-only link inside our org): s3://redwood-compliance/fintrust/exports/2026-05-14/

Completed files (samples included):
- s3-exports-20260514.json — list of object keys, sizes, last-modified, ETag (MD5) for the transcript + token buckets (approx. 1.2M entries, trimmed sample included)
- deletion-trace-20260514.log — DB purge job IDs, row counts, and timestamps (includes soft-delete and hard-delete events; we've redacted primary keys in samples)
- vector-index-purge-20260514.txt — index shard purge records with run IDs and summary counts
- hash-verification-report-20260514.txt — script run to compute and verify ETag/SHA256 for sample objects (job id: job-63b4f)

Operational notes: 
- We cannot provide raw tokens or unredacted transcripts; samples are redacted per the compliance playbook.
- One prior legal hold (2025-08-03 -> 2025-08-20) prevented two deletion jobs; I included the hold ticket and the release record.

If auditors need full manifest exports (untrimmed) we need a one-time read approval from infra (I've created infra ticket INFRA-8721).

David
SRE Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: s3-exports-20260514.json (json, 1.1MB)]

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
To: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@fintrust.com>, Audit Team <soc2-audit@fintrust.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention + deletion artifact list for SOC2 prep — package delivery

Hi Lara / Audit Team —

Per the timeline, attached is the consolidated package for Jan 1, 2025 — Apr 30, 2026. Summary below and direct links to hosted artifacts in our compliance bucket.

What we delivered (high level):
- retention-evidence-index-20260515.csv (mapping of policies -> artifacts -> locations -> owners)
- s3-exports-20260514.json (S3 manifest samples + ETags)
- deletion-trace-20260514.log (DB purge job logs; includes job IDs and timestamps)
- vector-index-purge-20260514.txt (index purge run IDs and counts)
- hash-verification-report-20260514.txt (sample verification steps and results)
- legal-holds-log.csv (exception records and release notes)
- retention-policy-refs.txt (policy text snippets + commit ids)

Links and access: 
- Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.redwood.example.com/Shared/Compliance/FinTrust/RetentionEvidence
- S3 path (internal): s3://redwood-compliance/fintrust/exports/2026-05-14/

Key controls called out for auditors: 
- TTL enforcement is driven by policy-engine v2.1 with periodic compaction jobs; compaction run IDs are in the index purge file.
- Deletion jobs log both soft-delete and hard-delete events; we surface job IDs that you can cross-reference with SRE logs.
- Hash verification performed on a statistically significant sample (see hash-verification-report) to show object-level deletion integrity.

Caveats/notes: 
- We have redacted PII and tokens in all samples; full manifests are available under INFRA-8721 approval.
- Embedding lifecycle includes ephemeral warm-shard files: I have documented the transient window in the retention-evidence-index.

Next steps we recommend for the audit team: 
- If you want full manifests, please let us know and confirm the exact scope; we will kick off the infra approval and a separate secure transfer workflow.
- If auditors want to validate retention scripting, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough with David next Tue.

If anything is missing or you need further artifacts, flag them and we'll prioritize.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
[attachments: retention-evidence-index-20260515.csv (csv, 18KB); retention-mapping-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 72KB); s3-exports-20260514.json (json, 1.1MB)]
